name: TartanAir
summary: 多种仿真场景中的连续相机轨迹，提供同步图像、深度、光流和位姿真值。
summaryEn: Continuous simulated camera trajectories with aligned images, depth, optical flow, and pose ground truth.
scaleZh: 原始项目记录 30 个仿真环境
organizations: Carnegie Mellon University AirLab and Microsoft
organizationsZh: 卡内基梅隆大学 AirLab 与微软
access: Official project provides dataset access instructions
accessZh: 官方项目提供数据访问说明
wmNote: 位姿与连续观测可支持运动条件未来观测建模；不默认包含执行器动作。
wmNoteEn: Poses and observations support motion-conditioned future views; actuator actions are not assumed.
